title: [Main]-[BC-IN] Purchase invoice with a deferral schedule and Non-availment GST is not functioning correctly
summary: Purchase invoices with non-availment GST and deferral templates now post correctly in the India localization by handling deferral validation in the tax engine.
key_points: Purchase invoices with non-availment GST failed to post when a default deferral template was configured on a G/L account
The base application's deferral validation was too strict for the tax engine scenario
A subscription to the OnBeforeCheckDeferralConditionForGenJournal event now provides localization-specific handling
The fix also resolves related journal voucher posting issues
Changes only affect the India tax base application
quote: Purchase invoice with Non-availment GST does not get posted when a Default Deferral Template is configured on the G/L Account Card.
